# Messify

> Messify is a Dubai meal-plan and catering company. Its meals are cooked fresh every day in a partner kitchen in International City and delivered as weekly and monthly meal plans across Dubai Academic City, Dubai Silicon Oasis, International City, Dubai Festival City (DFC), Al Aweer, Dubai Investments Park (DIP), Jebel Ali (JAFZA), Al Furjan and Dubai South, from AED 25.63 a meal. It also caters corporate events, parties, university events and weddings across Dubai, Sharjah, Ajman, Abu Dhabi, Ras Al Khaimah, Umm Al Quwain and Fujairah.

Messify sells daily meal plans through the Messify app. Each meal on a plan is a token: customers can skip a day and use the token later in their plan, or spend extra tokens to double up. Meals are delivered together in one chilled bag; orders are placed at least a day ahead (choose meals by 6 PM the day before, no same-day orders). The menu changes daily, all meals are 100% halal, and there is a vegetarian option every day, for every meal. Monthly plans are 26 days of meals to use within 30 days; weekly plans are 7 days of meals to use within 9 days. Meal plan delivery covers Dubai Academic City, Dubai Silicon Oasis, International City, Dubai Festival City (DFC), Al Aweer, Dubai Investments Park (DIP), Jebel Ali (including JAFZA), Al Furjan and Dubai South. In Academic City, Silicon Oasis, International City and DFC, all of the day's meals arrive together every morning.

## Meal plan prices (AED)
- 1 meal a day, weekly: AED 215 (7 meals, AED 30.71 per meal)
- 2 meals a day, weekly: AED 415 (14 meals, AED 29.64 per meal)
- 3 meals a day, weekly: AED 610 (21 meals, AED 29.05 per meal)
- 1 meal a day, monthly: AED 715 (26 meals, AED 27.50 per meal)
- 2 meals a day, monthly: AED 1,400 (52 meals, AED 26.92 per meal)
- 3 meals a day, monthly: AED 1,999 (78 meals, AED 25.63 per meal)
